The '''Equation Enclave''' was a structure that was part of [[Satikan]], a [[Gree (species)/Legends|Gree]] trading outpost on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Asation]]. During the [[Dread Host]]'s incursion on Asation, the [[Writhing Horror]] and its children overran the Enclave.<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Equation Enclave first appeared in the Operation "Terror From Beyond" in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.
